neighborhoods.name: Drexel Hill
neighborhoods.description: The township's largest and leafiest section — tree-lined streets of twins and single homes, with the Media/Sharon Hill trolleys (101/102) running through it
neighborhoods.character: Classic streetcar suburb, family-oriented, quietest part of the township

housing.predominantType: Twin homes and modest singles, 1920s-1950s stock

neighborhoods.character_notes: Trolley 101 to 69th Street or Media. The redeveloped Drexeline center (ShopRite anchor) covers daily shopping. Naylor's Run park nearby.

neighborhoods.name: 69th Street District / Terminal Square
neighborhoods.description: The commercial heart of the township around the 69th Street Transportation Center — a dense, extraordinarily diverse shopping and dining corridor
neighborhoods.character: Urban, transit-rich, immigrant-entrepreneur retail, always busy

housing.predominantType: Apartments over storefronts and mid-rise buildings

neighborhoods.character_notes: Market-Frankford El terminus, trolleys, and the Norristown High Speed Line converge here. H Mart, Fresh Grocer, the Tower Theater, and dozens of international restaurants and markets. Do block-by-block diligence in the immediate corridor at night.

neighborhoods.name: Highland Park
neighborhoods.description: Dense twin-home neighborhood on the hill west of 69th Street, one of the township's most internationally diverse residential areas
neighborhoods.character: Dense residential, diverse, walkable to the transit hub
neighborhoods.character_notes: Walkable to 69th Street shopping and the El. Strong South Asian, African, and Caribbean communities.

neighborhoods.name: Stonehurst
neighborhoods.description: Compact rowhome blocks in the township's southeast — its most affordable entry point
neighborhoods.character_notes: Cheapest rents in the township. Bus routes to 69th Street. Aging housing stock — inspect condition carefully.

neighborhoods.name: Westbrook Park
neighborhoods.description: Tidy postwar rowhome pocket near the Clifton Heights border, popular with long-time owners and downsizers

housing.predominantType: Postwar brick rowhomes with small yards

neighborhoods.character_notes: Near Westbrook Park shopping and bus routes on West Chester Pike.

neighborhoods.name: Kirklyn
neighborhoods.description: Small neighborhood on the Havertown border along West Chester Pike, blending Upper Darby affordability with Haverford Township adjacency
neighborhoods.character: Border neighborhood, quiet streets off a busy pike
neighborhoods.character_notes: Bus routes on West Chester Pike run straight to the 69th Street hub.
